definition_en: to make someone confused, or to muddle something completely
core_image: 说明书绕来绕去，读者越看越晕
scene: 攒了一下午家具，说明书却让他一头雾水。The confusing instructions befuddled him completely.
sceneCN: 这里 befuddled 是「使糊涂」（第 1 个义项：使头脑混乱不清）；句意是费解的说明书让他彻底晕头转向。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「使醉；使混乱」
由过去分词转形容词，义为「糊涂的；昏乱的」

senses.title: To confuse the mind
senses.definition: to make a person unable to think clearly
senses.example: The confusing instructions befuddled him completely.
senses.exampleCN: 费解的说明书让他彻底晕头转向。
senses.why: The be- prefix intensifies fuddle, an older word for muddling with drink.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 be- 强化 fuddle，后者本指因酒而神志不清。

senses.title: To muddle with drink
senses.definition: to make someone dazed, especially with alcohol
senses.definitionCN: 使人神志恍惚，尤指因饮酒
senses.example: Late nights and cheap wine left the poet befuddled each morning.
senses.exampleCN: 熬夜与劣酒让诗人每天早晨都昏昏沉沉。
senses.why: The word keeps its original tie to drink, where the mind literally fuddles.
senses.whyCN: 该词保留了与酒的原初联系——头脑确会因酒而浑沌。

intro.en: Befuddle adds the be- prefix to fuddle, an old drinking word.
intro.cn: befuddle 在古老的酒词 fuddle 前加 be- 前缀。

items.en: fuddle appeared in the sixteenth century, probably Low German, meaning to get tipsy; its deeper origin is uncertain.
items.cn: fuddle 十六世纪出现，一般认为来自低地德语，意为「微醺」，更早来源不确定。
十六至十七世纪 fuddle 意为「使醉」。

items.en: befuddle was formed as an intensified verb.
items.cn: 十八世纪强化动词 befuddle 构成。

items.en: the meaning widened from drink to any confusion.
items.cn: 十九世纪词义由酒扩展到一切困惑。

items.en: befuddled is now the usual form, for drink, fatigue, or jargon.
items.cn: 如今 befuddled 常用于形容醉酒、疲惫或术语造成的昏乱。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the be- prefix or the fuddle root; the near-meaning group gathers confusing words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 be- 前缀或 fuddle 词根；近义组汇集使困惑类词。

entries.definitionCN: 使醉；使混乱——befuddle 的基础词
使困惑；同用 be- 前缀
拥抱；只是拼写相近，词源不同
使混乱；最通用的对应词
使恍惚；强调震惊后的呆滞

normalIntro.en: Befuddle is fuddle with be-: drink and confusion in one word.
normalIntro.cn: befuddle 是 fuddle 加 be-：一个词装下酒与混乱。

normal.en: Fuddle alone means to make tipsy.
normal.cn: fuddle 单独用意为「使微醺」。

normal.en: Befuddled by drink is the oldest use.
normal.cn: befuddled by drink 是最古老的用法。

normal.en: The -ddle ending echoes muddle and puddle.
normal.cn: -ddle 词尾呼应 muddle 与 puddle。
过去式与过去分词是 befuddled。

normal.en: Bemuddle is a rare twin with the same sense.
normal.cn: bemuddle 是同义的罕用孪生词。

abstract.en: See a screw left over and three holes with no screws.
abstract.cn: 想象剩下一颗螺丝与三个空孔。

abstract.en: Feel the room tilt after the third glass.
abstract.cn: 感受第三杯酒后房间的倾斜。

abstract.en: Hear jargon swirl like fog in the ears.
abstract.cn: 听术语如雾在耳边打转。

examples.en: The confusing instructions befuddled him completely.
examples.cn: 费解的说明书让他彻底晕头转向。

examples.en: Late nights and cheap wine left the poet befuddled each morning.
examples.cn: 熬夜与劣酒让诗人每天早晨都昏昏沉沉。

examples.en: The sheer number of options befuddled the shoppers.
examples.cn: choices 太多，把顾客们都弄糊涂了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「比·发酵」——脑子像发酵的面团般越搅越糊，就是「昏乱糊涂」。

root: 前缀 be-（古英语，表「使、彻底」）加 fuddle；fuddle 十六世纪出现，一般认为借自低地德语 fuddeln「喝得微醺」，更早来源不确定；十八世纪组合成 befuddle，十九世纪起词义由「使醉」扩展为「使糊涂」。

sensesIntro.en: One verb dizzies the drinker first, then anyone facing too much jargon.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个动词，先醉倒饮酒者，再绕晕读术语的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mind stirring like yeast gone wrong.
core.cn: 核心意象：头脑如发酵过头的面团般浑沌。

intro.en: Befuddle stacks be- on fuddle, doubling the muddle.
intro.cn: befuddle 在 fuddle 上叠 be-，把「昏乱」再加一层。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; fuddle is Germanic, probably Low German.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，fuddle 属日耳曼语源，一般认为出自低地德语。

derivatives.zh: 基础词，义为「使醉；使混乱」
由过去分词转形容词，义为「糊涂的；昏乱的」
